chunks: And whatever was in Hā from Muḥammad ibn Manṣūr, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Muḥammad ibn Abī al-Ṣahbān, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Muḥammad ibn Manṣūr.

key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: Al-ʿAṭṭār; part of the identifying nisbah of a narrator in the chain.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the narrator.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration through this sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Muḥammad ibn Manṣūr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Muḥammad ibn Manṣūr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It is a chain clarification entry, documenting the author’s route of transmission rather than conveying a legal or theological matn.
